description: A two-oscillator drone voice with a sub, a bit crusher and sample rate reducer, two filters and three LFOs, in stereo

params.text: Sets how far apart the two output channels are spread in the stereo field
Sets the pitch of both oscillators
Sets the depth of frequency modulation on the oscillators
Sets the drive into the output stage
Turns the sub oscillator on and off
Detunes the second oscillator against the first
Sets the output level
Picks which of the eighty-eight wavetables the oscillators read
Reduces the bit depth of the output, turned up for a coarser signal
Sets how much of the second oscillator is mixed in
Sets the frequency of the first filter
Sets the frequency of the second filter
Reduces the sample rate of the output, turned up for a rougher signal
Sets the resonance of the second filter
Sets the resonance of the first filter
Sets how much of that LFO reaches its destination
Picks that LFO's waveform: Sine, Triangle, Ramp Up, Ramp Down, Square, Stepped Random or Smooth Random
Sets that LFO's rate within the band picked by its range switch
Picks the response of the first filter: Lowpass, Bandpass, Notch, Highpass or Off
Picks the response of the second filter: Lowpass, Bandpass, Notch, Highpass or Off
Picks the band that LFO's rate knob works in: Slow, Medium or Fast

inputs.text: Sets the pitch at a volt per octave, added to the pitch knob
The voltage that modulates the oscillator pitch, scaled by the FM knob; with nothing patched it takes LFO 3 at a fifth of its level
A voltage above 0V turns the sub oscillator on and anything lower turns it off, in place of the switch
Moves the wavetable selection, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt; with nothing patched LFO 1 moves it
Adds to the second oscillator's level in the mix, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the second oscillator's detuning, a fifth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the first filter's frequency, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the first filter's resonance, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the sample rate reduction, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Sets the bit depth from a voltage spanning -5V to 5V, replacing the knob for as long as a cable is patched
Adds to the second filter's frequency, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt; with nothing patched LFO 3 moves it at a fifth of its level
Adds to the second filter's resonance, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Moves that LFO's waveform selection, one waveform per two volts
Adds to that LFO's rate, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to that LFO's depth, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the stereo spread, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the drive, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the output level, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Audio patched here is fed through the filters and the output stage in place of the two oscillators

outputs.text: The left channel of the voice
The right channel of the voice
That LFO on its own jack, for use outside the module
